messages:
noah-sales: Heads-up: HealthCo POC started a full-load run and is seeing intermittent 429s. Demo in 2h, need quick triage.
tara-support: Which endpoint and a sample 429 body?
noah-sales: Mostly hitting /v1/completions. Their raw response (redacted):\n```json\n{\n  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",\n  "reason": "per_route_qps",\n  "route": "/v1/completions",\n  "retry_after": 6,\n  "req_id": "hc-7c3"\n}\n```\nnoah-sales: Client is firing ~35 concurrent short requests from their stress harness.
raj-eng: That error maps to a per-route QPS cap (not the monthly token budget). Trial tenants default per-route sustained RPS is ~100 and a short burst window of ~600 tokens/min. If they open a lot of concurrent short-lived requests, the bucket drains and you see rapid 429s with Retry-After.
ops-oncall: We can increase per-route RPS for that tenant for a short window. Do we want a 4h bump to 400 RPS or a burst increase only? Which is safer for the demo?
tara-support: For demos usually a temporary per-route RPS up to 300 for 3h is enough. Also send client mitigation steps.
noah-sales: Please apply 3h bump to 300 if ops agrees. I'll tell them it's temporary and to reduce concurrency after the demo.
ops-oncall: Queuing change now.
quota-bot: Quota change requested: tenant=healthco-poc, route=/v1/completions, rps=300, duration=10800s, id=Q-185000-01
quota-bot: Change applied. Expires at 1850015421.
raj-eng: Client guidance to share: 1) set client max_concurrency <= 12, 2) reuse HTTP keep-alive connections to reduce connection churn, 3) honor Retry-After header and backoff with full-jitter, 4) prefer streaming for long outputs to reduce per-request token spikes.
raj-eng: Backoff snippet (pseudocode): `base=0.5s; sleep = random_between(0, min(60, base * 2**attempt))` and if Retry-After provided use that value as min sleep.
tara-support: Note on tokens: embeddings and completions draw from the same tenant token pool (monthly usage) but per-route caps are independent. So you can hit per-route 429s even with low monthly usage.
noah-sales: Re-running their harness with new RPS cap... so far zero 429s in 10 minutes. They're happy, demo looks green.
ops-oncall: Keep an eye on SLO dashboards; I'll auto-revert at expiry. If they need sustained capacity we'll open a presales quota request.
tara-support: I'll follow up with a short troubleshooting doc and the client best-practices. Closing the support swarm unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
